spans.s:
अब्ज a. [अप्सु जायते, जण्-ड] Born
in or produced from water

--ब्जंः
1 The conch (n.
also).
--2 The moon.
--3 Camphor.
--4 N. of a tree (निचुल).
--5
Dhanvantari, physician of the gods,
said to be produced at the
churning of the ocean along with
other jewels.
--ब्जं
1 A lotus.
--2 One thousand millions.
--Comp.
--कर्णिका the seed vessel
of a lotus.
--जः, --भवः, --भूः, --योनिः
epithets of Brahmā, (being supposed
to have sprung from the lotus which
arose from the navel of Viṣṇu).
--दृश्, --नयन, --नेत्र, --लोचन &c. a.
lotuseyed, having large beautiful eyes.
--बांधवः ‘a friend of lotuses,’ the
sun.
--भोगह् {1} the root of a lotus.
{2} a cowrie (वराटक) as large as
a conch.
--वाहनः ‘carrying the moon
on his forehead,’ epithet of Śiva.
--(ना) ‘having the lotus for her seat,’
[]
N. of Lakṣmī.
--स्थितः N. of
Brahmā.
--हस्तः the sun (represented
as holding a lotus in one hand).

अब्जा m. (ब्जाः) Ved. Born in
water (

1 A lotus plant.
--2 A
collection of lotuses.
--3 A place full
of lotuses.
--Comp.
--पतिः the sun.
